About Fuerda Smartech

Fuerda Smartech is a technology powerhouse with over 497 national patents, standing at the forefront of automotive innovation.
We specialize in designing, developing, and manufacturing mid-to-high-end intelligent automotive electronic integrated control systems, cutting-edge lighting solutions, air vents, and other essential components for vehicles.

The Fuerda Smartech Group includes three R&D centers and five manufacturing bases located in Cixi, Ningbo, and Shanghai.
In Europe, the Group has a subsidiary and an R&D center in Germany, dedicated to development, project coordination, marketing services, and close cooperation with overseas OEMs.

In 2021, Fuerda established a manufacturing base in Romania to strengthen its supply capacity in Europe.
The Romanian plant specializes in producing air vents and lighting systems through plastic injection, lacquering, and assembly processes.

We are a company in full development in Romania, with a dynamic and ambitious team that values professionalism, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

About the Role

As a IT Specialist, you will be responsible for managing and securing the company’s entire IT infrastructure, covering both IT (administrative area) and OT (production environment).
The role is critical in ensuring system availability, network security, and smooth collaboration between office operations and manufacturing processes, as well as close collaboration with the IT team at the headquarters in Cixi, China.

Key Responsibilities

IT – Administrative Area

  • Administer on-premises Linux and Windows servers, including Active Directory and Group Policies (GPO)
  • Manage virtualization environments using VMware vSphere
  • Administer Microsoft Office 365 services
  • Manage and maintain IT network infrastructure (Cisco switching, Juniper firewalls, Cisco Wireless Controller)
  • Monitor systems and networks using tools such as PRTG Monitor and EventLog Analyzer
  • Administer endpoint security solutions (e.g. Bitdefender Gravity Zone – EDR)
  • Manage patching, backup and recovery solutions (Veeam Software)
  • Develop and maintain PowerShell automations
  • Provide advanced IT support (L1–L3) for systems and networks
  • Deliver helpdesk support for company users
  • Administer printers (Zebra, Xerox) and handheld devices / PDAs (Zebra)
  • Manage mobile devices (iOS & Android)
  • Maintain IT documentation, procedures, and asset management

OT – Production Area

  • Ensure IT/OT network segmentation and separation
  • Support security measures for industrial networks and access control
  • Monitor OT traffic and security-related events
  • Implement cybersecurity measures in industrial environments
  • Respond to incidents with potential OT impact
  • Collaborate closely with production teams and OT vendors
  • Manage backup solutions for production PCs

What We’re Looking For

·       Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical field is preferred

·       Minimum 5 years of experience in similar System & Network Administration roles, in manufacturing environments

·       Strong knowledge of networking and cybersecurity principles

·       Analytical mindset with the ability to react quickly to incidents

·       Advanced English level (written and spoken)

Nice to Have / Additional Advantages

  • Experience in OT / industrial environments
  • Knowledge of OT security concepts (IT/OT segmentation, ICS security)
  • Experience with SIEM / SOC solutions
  • Incident response and log analysis experience
  • Familiarity with ISO 27001 and IEC 62443 standards
  • Experience in security audits
  • IT or cybersecurity certifications
  • Skills in planning, budgeting, and vendor management

Your Profile

You are a person who:
✅ Is organized, rigorous, and proactive
✅ Can handle tight deadlines in a dynamic environment
✅ Inspires trust
✅ Communicates openly with both local and international colleagues
✅ Is flexible, solution-oriented, and shows professional integrity

We Offer

  • The 13-th salary – Paid once a year, in December;
  • Annual performance bonus (up to 10% of the gross annual salary, based on achieving the KPIs set in the previous year);
  • Meal tickets - With a value of 35 Lei and Benefit platform;
  • Christmas and Easter bonuses in gift vouchers;
  • Meal discounts for catering 15 lei brut;
  • Private Medical Services - Health is the most important, so we offer you a medical subscription through Medlife – Business package; SanoPass;
  • Company loyalty bonus (50% of your monthly salary after 5 years, and 100% after 10 years);
  • Referral bonuses - We encourage colleagues to refer new candidates to us and, at the same time, to get the chance to receive a bonus;
  • Extra vacation days – You start with 25 days of annual leave from day one (instead of the legal 20-day minimum);
  • Transport on predetermined routes.

              Your expertise will lead you further with us! We’re excited to meet you!
